target: Amsterdam school-based upper-secondary pupils per teacher FTE, all target providers
why_not_cap: OECD 2023 technical notes PDF page 422 state private-institution teacher counts are estimated from enrolments and public-school ratios; no one-sided error bound located. DUO personnel FTE page acknowledges missing institution data and national weighting; IPTO method page 2 explains personnel not on payroll excluded from Onderwijs in cijfers. No source establishes a complete actual upper bound on target teachers.
pupil_subset: DUO per-site 2021 pupil file identified but neither retrieved nor admitted; teacher-side failure makes partial interval unavailable.
year_alignment: 2021 Eurostat and OECD general methodology are not independently proven to be a single common reference-period observation; no matched school-year inference made.
